steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Equation vs Identity: Equation: True for specific values (e.g., 2x = 6 is true only when x = 3) Identity: True for ALL values, shown with ≡ symbol (e.g., 2(x + 3) ≡ 2x + 6) | Algebraic Proof: Using algebra to show that a mathematical statement is always true.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Prove that (x + 4)² - (x + 2)² ≡ 4(2x + 3) | Write an expression for two consecutive odd numbers and find their sum. | Prove that the sum of three consecutive even numbers is divisible by 6.
